static_traits.name: Li Bowen
static_traits.social_status: has several close friends to confide in, but they do not understand this specific issue
static_traits.medical_history: no significant physical illness; no similar problems before; never received psychotherapy or counseling
static_traits.language_features: clear expression, able to describe experiences specifically; fairly good logical thinking; rather negative tone but willing to try change; good self-Reflection ability; acceptable cooperation in sessions

basic_info.main_problem: I tend to negate positive feedback and only focus on negative comments, which affects my mood and self-esteem.
basic_info.core_demands: Continuously attending to negative feedback has significantly affected my emotions and work performance, so I hope to get help through counseling.
growth_experiences: after starting as a short-order Chef at a local restaurant, gradually formed a pattern of focusing only on negative feedback and negating positive reviews; initially moderate stress, mostly triggered by negative customer feedback, worsening over time, any criticism outweighing positive feedback. This pattern appears almost daily at Work, causing Low mood,Impaired self-esteem,Relationship with colleagues affected, and more Work mistakes.

core_beliefs: I am a failure/I am not competent at my Work
My value depends on others' evaluations(especially customers' feedback)

special_situations.event: during one dinner service, despite receiving many compliments, one guest said they did not like my dish, and my mood was strongly affected
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: if anyone is not satisfied, it means I did terribly and the whole day is ruined
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: repeatedly recalling that bad review, ignoring the evening's praise, staying gloomy hoping to 'remind myself not to make mistakes again'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: she did not like my dish, which means my cooking is terrible; the whole day is ruined

special_situations.event: In the same shift, receiving both the praise 'the burger is great' and the complaint 'the fries are too salty', with the negative review completely outweighing the positive one
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: if I cannot even make simple fries well, I must be a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Self-reproach and becoming overly tense at work, trying thereby to avoid being criticized again (which instead makes mistakes more likely)
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I cannot even make fries well,I am just a failure

special_situations.event: At work, even when several customers praise me, I still automatically ignore the positive feedback and fixate on one negative review
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: praise usually does not count, what truly reflects ability is criticism
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Selectively attends to negative information; tries to remind themselves of positive evaluations but finds it hard to persist, and eventually returns to the negative cycle
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: those compliments do not count, what really shows the problem is criticism

special_situations.event: when interacting with colleagues,Low mood after being affected by negative feedback, irritable and Avoids communication
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: I should always be friendly, cannot have negative emotions, otherwise I am a bad colleague
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: forcefully Repressing emotions, reducing contact with colleagues, with 'outbursts/talking back' after emotions accumulate
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I should be friendlier, cannot let others see my state

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and affirmed, proving oneself competent and valuable
core_conflict.fear: fear of being negated as a 'failure', fear of others' criticism and rejection
defense_goal: reducing the risk of being negated again through harsh self-blame and avoiding others
Displacing Sense of frustration onto safer targets to relieve tension

object_relations.self_representation: an incompetent employee, prone to failure, needing others' approval
object_relations.object_representation: harsh, picky judges (customers/others) who may negate oneself at any time

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: Interacts with colleagues after receiving negative customer feedback at work
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Displacing the frustration and anger caused by customer feedback onto colleagues, experiencing colleagues as 'annoying' objects
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: impatient tone, short responses, reduced eye contact and communication, occasional talking back or cold treatment.

exception_events.target_problem: when receiving mixed positive and negative feedback,Li Bowen usually ignores praise, focuses only on negative reviews, and thus feels Low mood and performs worse.
exception_events.unique_outcome: Once a customer praised his burger as 'the best I have had in a long time'; he felt very happy in the moment and briefly experienced 'I really did well'.
exception_events.reason: different supports/contexts: positive feedback is clear, specific, strong and timely; such concrete affirmation is easier to notice and briefly internalize.

positive_force: Willing to try changing and engage in counseling
Able to notice her own thinking patterns (such as ignoring positive feedback)
Has received clear and strong positive feedback at work
Has a few close friends who can provide basic support
negative_force: persistent mental filtering and positive-negating thought patterns
Excessively relies on external evaluation to determine self-worth
Bringing frustration into colleague relationships, increasing tension and conflict
negative feedback unavoidable in the Work environment, high trigger frequency, forming a vicious cycle

target_behavior.behavior: persistently ruminating on negative reviews and negating positive feedback after receiving negative evaluations, mood dropping rapidly
antecedent: When mixed positive and negative feedback appears in the same situation
target_behavior.core_reason: Self-worth highly depends on others' evaluations, with catastrophizing and black-and-white cognitive patterns
target_behavior.function: gaining a sense of control and the illusion of self-correction through harsh self-blame and problem-focus, escaping uncertainty and anxiety in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: Low mood and Impaired self-esteem, distracted attention leading to more errors,Decline in work performance

target_behavior.behavior: irritable with colleagues or Avoids communication
antecedent: Just after receiving a negative customer review at work
When feeling like a failure and exhausted
target_behavior.core_reason: Displacing frustration and anger toward customers/oneself onto colleagues as a safer target
target_behavior.function: Short-term release of tension and avoidance of further social exposure
target_behavior.consequence: Damaged relationships with colleagues, team Decreased support, further worsening Work atmosphere and performance
